title: Titan X Pink Burst Prefilled Pod + Refills
description: The Titan X Refill Kit in Pink Burst is designed for use with the Titan X Prefilled Pod Vape Kit. This easy-to-use refill pack includes a 2ml prefilled mouthpiece pod and three 5ml flavour-matched auto-refill capsules, ensuring a long-lasting, consistent vape without the need for messy refills. Just click the pod and capsules into place on your Titan X device and you’re ready to go. The Pink Burst flavour delivers a confectionery-inspired blend of juicy fruit chews, offering bright, sweet notes with a satisfyingly fruity finish. Balanced and smooth with every puff, this flavour profile is enhanced by a smooth nicotine salt formulation for a comfortable mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping experience and rapid nicotine relief. Featuring a pre-installed mesh coil for consistently clear flavour and smooth vapour, the Titan X Refill Kit combines with the Titan X device’s intelligent auto-refill technology to offer up to approximately 10,000 puffs per refill cycle (usage-dependent).
